text: Fried Rice at Eddie's is playable in the browser, with a game select menu.
The title music stops when a night starts, and the bottom button bar is gone.
Spinning rice bowl loading screen that starts by itself.
Mods, a new Settings screen, a new menu font and real text on the custom night.
Full character drawings everywhere, with the faces as their own files.
Mod template: every picture as a PNG, and mods can use any image type.
The fan-made cast is used everywhere, and the animation is smoother.
Smooth movement, turning, resizing and fading (like TurboWarp).
The whole game was rewritten by hand as a real browser game (no Scratch converter).
New tab icons: the rice bowl for the menu, Eddie for this tape.
The whole box around SETTINGS can be clicked.
Three save files, picked on the menu. Mods are saved in the browser.
New phone calls for nights 1 to 4, with a ringtone before each call.
iPhone-style call banner with a green caller circle.
Steam-style achievements (saved per file), and the camera name shows on the monitor.
Child's Play achievement (custom night with everyone on 3 or lower) and a BACK button on the custom night.
Debug mode: no saving and no achievements while it is on.
The custom night is always on the title menu. Night 6 still needs nights 1 to 5 beaten.
Tape 2 is here: Fried Rice at Eddie's 2, a FNaF 2 style night.
Rigged 3D models for Toy Eddy, Toy Weddy, Toy Cheddy and Toy Endo.
Both tapes are now plain web pages with the code inside.
The toys are drawn from their 3D models.
Characters are drawn live from the models folder, with less lag. Fred makes the phone calls.
Fixed the stutter once characters start moving.
Aidan's own office.
Smoother drawing. No static anywhere in Tape 2.
Mods can add 3D models and 2D characters (models and characters folders).
Mods have no limits: code, new pictures and sounds, any file, and no more 5 MB cap.
Uploaded models follow the game's rig, and their looping animations play.
The toys have faces (calm, creepy and scary). Mangled Endo is now Meyg.
Custom night: a red star over each character's right eye, stronger the harder they are.
Custom night: the "F*CK NO!" preset, everyone on 20.
GET READY minigame: the rainbow Endo runs, and the last run ends in a huge fire.
After the GET READY run the title reads "Eddies Riceria" with the crying rainbow guy.
New tab icon: the rainbow guy.
The death minigame depends on who caught you (still 1 in 3).
The Eddy mask, and the withered cast is torn up and broken.
Toy Weddy's new model.
Aidan's new Puppet.
The toys breathe while they stand, and each toy has its own 3D jumpscare.
No idle animation on the title screen and custom night portraits.
Custom night: < on 0 jumps to 20 and > on 20 jumps to 0 (not when held or spammed).
The toys crawl in the vents and walk down the hall. Sharp close-up on the title screen.
No static noise on the cameras or the flashlight. New fan sound with rain.
No more vent light hum.
Aidan's newspaper ad at the start of a new game.
Cheddy takes Bonnie's spots and Weddy takes Chica's.
Withered Endo no longer kills you right away: survive his stare minigame.
Aidan's new mask.
Toy Weddy takes her face plate off when she leaves the stage: a glitching black box covers her face.
Balloon Boy is now the Peepeepoopoo Monster.
Toy Weddy wears a shirt, and her chest wobbles with real physics.
After every death: a VHS STOP screen and a guide on how to survive whoever got you.
DOORS "Self" plays during the VHS guide.
Devlog button in Settings: every update to the game.
A warning screen when the game starts: sensitive content on or off. Off turns jumpscares off. It can skip itself on that save file.
A new phone call on night 1.
The Puppet's music box on CAM 11 plays a new song.
New Settings button on the tape menu for every tape: brightness, picture quality, master/music/sound volume.
Parental settings (with an optional PIN): block mods, block jumpscares, story mode only, and chicken mode (10x easier, no achievements).
Accounts: sign in to keep your save files, settings and mods on any device.
Workshop! Settings > Mods > LOAD PACKED > WORKSHOP: browse and install mods other players published, no account needed.
With an account you can publish your unpacked mods to the Workshop, edit them later, and mark them mature (hidden from the list, link only).
Mods are uploaded as one picture (the whole mod packed into its pixels) and turned back into the real files when loaded.
PICK .ZIP also takes a mod image (.png), so a mod can be shared as a single picture.
No more mod limit: mods are saved entirely in the browser's file storage (not the small 5 MB storage), so huge mods load fine. Old mods move over by themselves.
The Mods screen shows how much room your browser gives mods.

New Font setting (menu Settings > Visuals, and each tape's Settings): Original, Dyslexic (OpenDyslexic) and whoo hoo super mario on the ps4 (every word memified). It changes words only, never pictures.
Tape 2: beating a night now shows a Windows XP pop-up that bounces around the screen like the Solitaire win. Hit its yay button (good luck) to skip it and get a secret achievement.
Demo until October 31 at 1 PM: Tape 1 has Night 1 and Dine In, and Tape 2 shows a countdown. Everything opens on release day.
Story Mode (Tape 0 on the menu): play every tape in order on one path, nights 1 to 5 then the 6th night and custom night. Beat nights to earn EXP and level up your account.
Shop in Story Mode: trade EXP for items that work in every night while signed in: Frying Pan, Stopwatch, Battery Pack, X-Ray Glasses, Bear Trap and Air Horn. Spending EXP never lowers your level.
Pause menu: press Esc (or the II button in the corner) during a night. Resume, Journal, Settings or Quit. The night also pauses itself when you switch tabs.

The Journal (in the pause menu): a help guide on the blue VHS screen with Entities, Mechanics, Items, Cameras and Summary chapters, with routes, how to stop each one, little camera maps and pixel icons.
The night goes a little faster while the cameras are up.
Tape 2: the mask has an oxygen bar. Run out of air and the mask comes off for 15 seconds, everyone moves 1 or 2 steps closer, and the screen goes dark red while you catch your breath.
Tape 2: the music box winds down a little faster while you wear the mask.
New limited achievement: OG. Play between Oct 24 and Nov 10, 2026 to get it, plus a free 500 EXP on your account (once) if you are signed in.

You can pause on the title screen and the custom night screen too. The pause button moved to the top right corner, and the pause menu has a new button that takes you back to the tape select menu (or the Story Mode hub).
